title: SCR 1012 (2008 - Forty-eighth Legislature - Second Regular Session (azleg session id 86)): secure and verifiable identification
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Bill text (para 1)
(quote) 1. Under the power of the referendum, as vested in the Legislature, the following measure, relating to identification requirements for the disbursement of public services, is enacted to become valid as a law if approved by the voters and on proclamation of the Governor:
(section) Sec. 1: Title 41, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended by adding chapter 44, to read: (para A)
(quote) Law enforcement services shall not be withheld because of the presentation of an unverifiable identification document, but the unverifiable document cannot be used to establish identity.
(b_no_id_remedy)
(section) Bill text
(quote) REFERENCE TITLE: secure and verifiable identification
(section) Sec. 1: Title 41, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended by adding chapter 44, to read:
(quote) SECURE AND VERIFIABLE IDENTIFICATION
(section) Sec. 2: Legislative history
(quote) During the 2005 legislative session, the legislature enacted S.B. 1511, secure and verifiable identification.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) Bill text
(quote) enacting and ordering the submission to the PEOPLE of a MEASURE relating to identification REQUIREments for the disbursement of PUBLIC services.
(section) Bill text
(quote) amending TITLE 41, Arizona Revised Statutes, by adding chapter 44; relating to identification requirements.
(section) Sec. 1: Title 41, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended by adding chapter 44, to read:
(quote) Identification requirements; exceptions; consequences; definitions
(section) Sec. 1: Title 41, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended by adding chapter 44, to read: (para A)
(quote) A. For the disbursement of public services, including law enforcement services, in this state that require recipients to produce identification, a department, agency, commission, board or district of this state or a political subdivision of this state shall not accept or recognize any identification document unless the document was issued by a political subdivision of this state, a federally recognized indian tribe or a state or federal authority and is verifiable by a law enforcement or homeland security agency.
(section) Sec. 1: Title 41, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended by adding chapter 44, to read: (para A)
(quote) A political subdivision of this state shall not authorize acceptance of an unverifiable identification document and a public official acting in the capacity of a public official shall not accept, acknowledge or recognize anything other than a verifiable identification document.
(section) Sec. 1: Title 41, Arizona Revised Statutes, is amended by adding chapter 44, to read: (para A)
(quote) For the purpose of issuing any form of identification, license, permit or official document to any person, a political subdivision of this state shall not rely on, or use in any manner, any document other than a verifiable identification document.
